transformations.name: Rogue
transformations.description: Every 6th hit you land readies a vanish. The next hit on you misses and you teleport away.

transformations.name: Thief
transformations.description: Bumping into an enemy steals 20% of their next hit on you (up to 60%). Your next hit adds what you stole.

transformations.name: Saw
transformations.description: Backstab becomes a saw that latches on and keeps cutting for up to 3s, until you're hit or parried.

transformations.name: Trickster
transformations.description: Every 1.5s, throw your dagger at a nearby enemy like a boomerang. It hits on the way out and back for half damage, and can crit.

transformations.name: Ambidextrous
transformations.description: Gain a second dagger.

transformations.name: Slippery
transformations.description: 20% chance for a hit to slide right off you, sending you skidding away.

transformations.name: Careful
transformations.description: Each parry adds +1 damage to your next crit (up to +6).

transformations.name: Swashbuckler
transformations.description: Your dagger becomes a longer cutlass, and Backstab becomes a slash that sends a wave at the enemy. The wave crits everyone it passes through. With Saw, the wave chases its target and saws them.

transformations.name: Portaler
transformations.description: Drop Slam falls through the floor and out of the ceiling before it lands. 60% longer cooldown.

transformations.name: Valkyrie
transformations.description: During Drop Slam your mace becomes a wing on each side, and you steer three times as fast.

transformations.name: Metalworker
transformations.description: Build up to +4 damage while you avoid taking damage. Your next hit uses it all.

transformations.name: Pilot
transformations.description: Drop Slam can also rocket upwards into the ceiling.

transformations.name: Crusher
transformations.description: A Drop Slam hit stuns the enemy for 2.5s. Stunned enemies deal 70% less damage, take 30% more and move slower.

transformations.name: Rubber Mace
transformations.description: A Drop Slam hit sends the enemy bouncing around the arena, taking damage every time they hit a wall.

transformations.name: Kamikaze
transformations.description: When Drop Slam lands, you explode, hitting every enemy nearby for 40% of the slam's damage and blasting them away.

transformations.name: Devil
transformations.description: When Drop Slam lands, a pillar of fire rises from floor to ceiling and burns enemies that touch it.

transformations.name: Non-Euclidean
transformations.description: Drones can attack through the walls. A drone that comes through a wall always crits.

transformations.name: Ace
transformations.description: Instead of guarding you, drones near an enemy pull you away from it.

transformations.name: Legion
transformations.description: Twice as many smaller drones, each dealing 60% damage.

transformations.name: Fighters
transformations.description: Drones circle enemies and shoot them instead of ramming them.

transformations.name: Daredevils
transformations.description: Drones fly 50% faster and leave trails of fire.

transformations.name: Slicers
transformations.description: Drones latch on and keep cutting until the enemy hits you, blocks something or touches a wall.

transformations.name: Fortress
transformations.description: Bigger drones that take two hits to knock away and guard twice as well, but are a little slower and weaker.

transformations.name: Wingmen
transformations.description: Gain two extra drones that ram approaching enemies away from you.

transformations.name: Six-Shooter
transformations.description: Every shot is banked off a wall at the nearest enemy. Bullets only hurt after they bounce, but always crit.

transformations.name: Shotgun
transformations.description: Fire your whole magazine at once in a spread, and reload faster.

transformations.name: SMG
transformations.description: Swap your gun for an SMG: a 30-round magazine fired 3.5 times as fast, for a quarter of the damage per bullet.

transformations.name: High-Ex
transformations.description: Bullets explode when they pass close to an enemy or get blocked, hitting everyone nearby for half damage.

transformations.name: Grenadier
transformations.description: Throw grenades at nearby enemies. You carry 3, and get them back 9s after throwing the last.

transformations.name: Bayonet
transformations.description: A blade on the end of your gun stabs enemies up close for half damage.

transformations.name: Hotshot
transformations.description: Bullets leave a trail of fire, and deal 20% more damage to burning enemies.

transformations.name: Merlin
transformations.description: Every few seconds, swing a magical Excalibur in a wide, fast sweep. Every hit it lands conjures a new orb.

transformations.name: Evoker
transformations.description: When an orb pops, two half-size orbs appear on the far side of your orbit. They pop for 20% damage and don't split again.

transformations.name: Pyromancer
transformations.description: Your orbs become a ring of fire around you that rapidly burns anyone touching it, a little at a time, through any guard. The more orbs you have built up, the faster it burns. Other elements change the ring. Damage upgrades (Sharpened, Critical Hits, Sabotage, Echo) add only 35% as much to the ring.

transformations.name: Aeromancer
transformations.description: Your orbs become airballs: they hit a little softer but blast enemies far away, and anyone blasted takes damage when they slam into a wall. With Pyromancer, the ring blasts away whoever it burns.

transformations.name: Hydromancer
transformations.description: Your orbs become bubbles that hit 15% harder. Anyone a bubble pops on is soaked for 3s: 30% slower and taking 35% more damage from hits. With Pyromancer, the ring scalds: anyone it burns is soaked more lightly (20% slower, 20% more damage).

transformations.name: Geomancer
transformations.description: Your orbs become long stone spikes pointing out from your orbit. They reach much further and hit 25% harder, but shatter in a small burst. With Pyromancer, stone spikes jut from the ring, so it burns further out.

transformations.name: Wild Magic
transformations.description: Your orbs wriggle about like worms, wandering far from the orbit, and you can hold one more. Each pop leaves a random effect on whoever it hits: a burn, a soaking, a gust that slams them into the next wall, or a broken guard. With Pyromancer, the ring flickers with colour and hexes whoever it burns about once a second.

transformations.name: Artificer
transformations.description: Every few seconds, leave an artificial orb behind you. It hangs in the air for 9s and pops for 60% damage on any enemy that touches it.

transformations.name: Abyss Warlock
transformations.description: Wherever two tentacles cross, an abyss opens: a circle that hurts anyone in it every 0.4s, for 40% of a lash's damage per tentacle touching it.

transformations.name: Puppeteer
transformations.description: Every 3rd time an enemy bounces off a wall, a portal tears open where they hit it, with a tentacle reaching out of it to your last portal.

transformations.name: Ensnarer
transformations.description: An enemy that comes near one of your portals sets it off: a burst blasts out of it, hitting everyone around it for 4 times a lash's damage and throwing them off the wall. The portal stays open, and can burst again after 2.5s.

transformations.name: Satanist
transformations.description: Every 10s, a huge red pentagram is drawn across the arena. A moment later it burns: anyone on its lines takes 14 damage.

transformations.name: Priest
transformations.description: Your tome turns holy and your tentacles become beams of light. While you're in one of your beams, it heals you for 25% of a lash's damage every lash.

transformations.name: Bestial Worshipper
transformations.description: When an enemy is close, maul them with quick feral swipes for 2.5 damage each. Every swipe leaves them 10% more vulnerable to damage, up to 30%, for 2.5s.

transformations.name: Arsonist
transformations.description: A pool of lava runs along the whole bottom of the arena. Enemies in it take 1.5 damage every 0.5s and are set burning, and keep burning for 2s after they climb out. It doesn't hurt you.

transformations.name: Witch
transformations.description: A raven familiar circles you and swoops at the nearest enemy every 1.4s, pecking for 1.8 damage. Weapons and shields can swat it away, sending it back to you to rest a little longer.
